checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Last x is overlapped and mangled by the wrench handle, so it reads as KwickFix plus a distorted x.

must.item: Name legible and not obscured by the mark
must.why: The wrench collides with the final x and hides part of it.

must.item: Small orange wrench with black lettering
must.why: The wrench is small and orange, and the lettering is black.

must.item: White background, no slogan or extra text
must.why: The background is plain white and there is no other text.

exact_text.read_as: KwickFix followed by a final x partly merged with the wrench

faults.what: The wrench overlaps and merges with the final x, which obscures the letter and makes it look like a glitch.
The wrench handle tip has a dark, smudged artefact where it meets the x.
The composition is a wide wordmark with a lot of empty space, and the wrench sits awkwardly at the edge.

summary: The logo is square with black KwickFixx lettering, a small orange wrench and a white background, but the wrench collides with and mangles the final x, so the name is not cleanly legible.
